question: Is the compatible remote snapshot service deployed and approved for Gitcrawl to make successful publication cut over unpinned readers by default in this release?
rationale: The final behavior intentionally changes a cross-service protocol, existing failure modes, and reader state; only release ownership can confirm the private deployment and accept the coordinated rollout and rollback obligations.

options.title: Approve proven rollout
options.body: Merge after live end-to-end evidence and the exact compatible remote revision, deployment order, and rollback steps are recorded.

options.title: Keep cutover explicit
options.body: Land snapshot staging and publication while requiring an explicit operator action to move unpinned readers.

options.title: Defer cloud-v2
options.body: Hold the draft until the remote service contract and coordinated release plan are established.

recommendation.title: Approve proven rollout
recommendation.body: Merge after live end-to-end evidence and the exact compatible remote revision, deployment order, and rollback steps are recorded.

likelyOwner.reason: The signed-release preparation history makes him the strongest available owner for cross-repository version and rollout acceptance, while Vincent Koc owns the implementation details.
